card.name: Inside drug names before dosage form
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug's full name, such as a salt ending (-ate, -inate, -rate, -ide) or a comma, just before the dosage form (tablets, injection, nasal spray, capsules). Also seen partway through longer drug names.

modes.label: Salt ending before dosage form
modes.description: The final part of a salt name like mesylate, succinate, nitrate, acetate or hydrochloride, right before tablets, injection or spray.
